coverage: Selective Podgorica launch from eight named city venues: music, theatre, film, team games, a temporary exhibition and a trade fair. The official tourism calendar was read across14 actual pages with134 observed cards; duplicates, stale linked dates and default23:59 ends were not promoted. Selected full organizer and event bodies were checked, not every observed card.22 timed sessions and2 real date ranges; visiting hours are not performances. November1 and several later dates have no verified timed listing; late November and category coverage remain sparse. Outlying Blizna is held separately, not counted as Podgorica. Gallery weekly hours are retained as guidance only, not verified holiday or open-now windows. Public Telegram announcements were read without complete fresh imports; city chats were profile-only, not read conversations.
